comments.author: Tron
comments.body_html:
The military contract version of the gun would be full-auto, as it’d be a service rifle.

You are referring to the civilian contract rifle being imported into the US. The civilian variant would be semi-auto to comply with US regulations.

For this particular variant of the gun in this mod, Civok, the modeler, chose to recreate the full-auto variant, denoted by its 3- position selector switch on the weapon. Safe, Semi, and Full-Auto. If you look closely on the model in-game, you’ll see all three modes.

Here is a picture of the selector switch for its real-world counterpart.
